title: The National Days of Prayer Movement in Europe
description: A movement encouraging the establishment of a National Day of Prayer at the country level in every European country — fostering unity through common prayer for our nations, freedom, peace and a prosperous future.
heroEyebrow: A call to the nations of Europe
heroTitle: The National Days of Prayer Movement in Europe
heroVerse: “… if my people, who are called by my name, humble themselves and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven and forgive their sin, and heal their land.”
heroCta2: How to establish a National Day of Prayer
missionText: The mission of the National Days of Prayer Movement in Europe is to encourage the establishment of a National Day of Prayer at the country level in every European country, fostering unity among the peoples of Europe through common prayer for their nations, freedom, the common good, peace, and a prosperous future for the European continent.
benefitsEyebrow: The case for a National Day of Prayer
benefitsTitle: Benefits of establishing a National Day of Prayer at the country level
benefitsLede: A National Day of Prayer is more than a date in the calendar. Across Europe it has proved to be a point of unity for society, a strengthening of the state, and a shared platform for churches and religious communities.
societyItems: Strengthening national unity and social solidarity.
Fostering a culture of mutual respect, trust, and responsibility.
Inspiring hope and resilience during times of crisis and challenge.
Encouraging charity, compassion, and service to others.
stateItems: Uniting citizens around a shared vision for the nation’s future.
Strengthening national identity and social stability.
Promoting a culture of responsible citizenship.
Supporting peace, social cohesion, and national security.
Demonstrating respect for spiritual heritage and freedom of religion.
churchItems: Advancing interfaith and interdenominational dialogue and cooperation.
Uniting believers in prayer for their nation and its people.
Strengthening the role of churches in serving society and local communities.
Creating a common platform for spiritual unity.
Affirming the importance of faith, hope, and moral values in public life.
historyTitle: From the Middle Ages to the present day
historyLede: Spiritual and national leaders across Europe have called their peoples to unite in prayer during critical moments of challenge and decision. These initiatives strengthened social cohesion, inspired hope and faith, and in certain instances played a significant role in events that shaped the destiny of nations.

cards.alt: Winston Churchill, Prime Minister of Great Britain, 1940–45
cards.title: United Kingdom — a story of victory
cards.text: Four days after taking office, Winston Churchill declared a national day of prayer. Five days later came news of the successful evacuation of British troops from Dunkirk.

cards.alt: St. Nicholas Church in Leipzig, centre of the Peace Prayer movement
cards.title: The Leipzig Peace Prayer Movement
cards.text: Weekly Prayer Meetings for Peace and Freedom at the Nikolaikirche grew into a nationwide movement that helped bring down the Berlin Wall.

cards.alt: Interfaith prayer service at St. Sophia Cathedral in Kyiv
cards.title: Joint prayer by European leaders in Kyiv
cards.text: On 24 February 2026 an interfaith prayer service was held at St. Sophia Cathedral, attended by the President of Ukraine and leaders from across Europe.

ukraineTitle: Ukraine — the first country in Europe
ukraineP1: On 12 February 2025 the Parliament of Ukraine passed a resolution establishing 24 February as the National Day of Prayer — making Ukraine the first European country to recognise a National Day of Prayer at the country level.
ukraineP2: The first National Day of Prayer was observed on 24 February 2025, within days of the law being adopted. A year later, on 24 February 2026, the day was marked by an interfaith prayer service at St. Sophia Cathedral in Kyiv — the first official, intergovernmental prayer of its kind, attended by the President of Ukraine together with heads of state and government from across the continent.
ukraineAlt: Resolution of the Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine establishing the National Day of Prayer
quoteText: The history of Europe reminds us that prayer has often been a powerful force for unity, renewal, and hope for future generations.
quoteCite: The National Days of Prayer Movement in Europe
ctaTitle: Bring a National Day of Prayer to your nation
ctaLede: Whether you represent a church, a religious community, a public institution or a group of citizens — the practical framework, the legal precedents and the coordination network are ready for you.
